reactions.speaker: Donald Trump
reactions.outlet: Truth Social (via Tribune India/ANI; Yahoo Finance)
reactions.quote: The NVIDIA Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO.

reactions.speaker: Donald Trump
reactions.quote: The Country needs Jensen's leadership at NVIDIA in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy.
reactions.context: Same post; ties Huang's return to the US economy. Printed by ANI as two adjacent segments.

reactions.speaker: Donald Trump
reactions.outlet: Truth Social (via Tribune India/ANI; Yahoo Finance)
reactions.quote: The United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen's return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security.

reactions.speaker: Donald Trump
reactions.quote: The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct.

reactions.speaker: Donald Trump
reactions.quote: Separately, NVIDIA should continue its thorough internal investigation of the Company's compliance with U.S. export controls in order to ensure that it is fulfilling its legal obligations and Patriotic Duty to protect U.S. National Security.
reactions.context: Same post; caveat urging continued export-control compliance review. Printed by ANI as two adjacent segments.

reactions.speaker: Donald Trump
reactions.quote: Congratulations to Jensen, the NVIDIA Board, to the People of the United States — and, indeed, the World,
reactions.context: Same post; closing congratulations (ANI's excerpt ends mid-sentence).
